Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is 58 years old, exceeding the upper age limit of 57.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: One or more of three risk factors--hypertension, hypercholesterolemia, and cigarette smoking
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has hypercholesterolemia (diagnosed at age 45 with LDL >190 mg/dL) and a 20-year smoking history (20 pack-years).

The patient has a documented history of recurrent severe myocardial infarctions, coronary artery bypass grafting, and is diagnosed with coronary artery disease (Stage III) and ischemic cardiomyopathy.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has confirmed coronary heart disease, including recurrent myocardial infarctions, stenting, and bypass surgery.

Recap: The patient exceeds the age limit (58 vs. 35-57), has coronary heart disease (disqualifying), and meets the risk factor criteria (hypercholesterolemia and smoking history).
